Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.mathoperations

Record Class Matrix2x2

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.backend.mathoperations.Matrix2x2
Record Components:
a00 - The matrix elements:
public record Matrix2x2(double a00, double a01, double a10, double a11) extends Record
Matrix2x2 is a record class representing a 2x2 matrix.

A 2x2 matrix is represented as: 

 | a00 a01 |
 | a10 a11 |

Since:
0.0.0 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)

  • Method Details

    • multiply

      public Vector2D multiply(Vector2D vector)
      Multiplies this matrix by a given Vector2D.

      The multiplication of a 2x2 matrix with a vector [x, y]^T (T = transposed) is given by: 

       | a00 a01 |   | x |   | a00*x + a01*y |
 | a10 a11 | * | y | = | a10*x + a11*y |

      Parameters:
      vector - The vector to multiply.
      Returns:
      The resulting Vector2D.
      Since:
      0.0.0
